command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$projects=@('CampusNetwork-for-perf','CampusNetwork-for-perf_02','CampusNetwork-for-perf_04','CampusNetwork_02','CampusNetwork_03','CampusNetwork_04','CampusNetwork_05','CampusNetwork_06','CampusNetwork_07','CampusNetwork_08','CampusNetwork_09'); `$nodes=@('PE1','PE2','PE3'); `$cmd='display current-configuration'; foreach(`$p in `$projects){foreach(`$n in `$nodes){`$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$cmd); try{`$r=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u; if(`$r.output -notlike 'Error:*'){`$hits=(`$r.output -split '\n') | Where-Object {`$_ -match 'sysname|isis [0-9]|isis cost|description to_PE|ip route-static 160'}; Write-Output ('===== '+`$p+' :: '+`$n+' ====='); `$hits}}catch{}}}"
